your_games.title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0.1 is live with save fixes
your_games.body: Jagex's "Eye on Ashenfall" update finally lands the promised fixes for disappearing world saves, plus a catch-up for corrupted characters that drops you back in with aggregated stats and Tier 4 gear. Jagex says a very small number of players may still hit other save issues. It also adds a "Death From Above" jump attack, new ranged perks like Ammo Recovery and Low Blow (leg shots slow enemies), and bumps the inventory from 32 to 40 slots.

your_games.title: Enshrouded 1.0 launches today on PS5 and PC
your_games.body: Keen Games' co-op survival-crafting RPG leaves early access and debuts on PS5 today. 1.0 opens the full Embervale map, adds the new Cinder's Cradle biome (lava wastes below, floating islands above), full voice acting and an ending to the current story. Keen's press release puts launch at 16:00 CEST, which is 16:00 SAST, though some reports say the PS Store listing shows a later unlock. It's $39.99 with 10% off for the first 14 days. Xbox follows in spring 2027.

your_games.title: PS Plus Extra and Premium for October
your_games.body: Sony's catalog line-up is Mafia: The Old Country, Horizon Forbidden West, Mycopunk, Poppy Playtime: Chapter 2, The Midnight Walk, Tales of Arise: Beyond the Dawn Edition and Monster Energy Supercross 25. Premium adds Dino Crisis 2 and RollerCoaster Tycoon 3 Complete Edition. Outside the US, UK and Japan, everything arrives on Tuesday 20 Oct. Heads-up: PlayStation LifeStyle notes GTA V is a confirmed departure next month, with the full leaving list due on 20 Oct.

your_games.title: Rockstar opens up about GTA 6's long development
your_games.body: In a Bloomberg feature, Rockstar confirmed GTA 6 started as the over-ambitious "Project Americas" and cited the difficulty of defining realism, complex AI, remote-work limits and a three-way leadership structure. It denied a reported $1.5 billion budget without giving the real number, and technical lead Phil Hooker said the new engine and tools should make future games faster. Launch is still 19 Nov.

your_games.title: Diablo IV patch fixes the Prime Evil quest bug
your_games.body: Blizzard's small update stops characters using a Splinter of a Prime Evil before finishing the Seasonal questline, which locked them out of Prime Evil Powers. Already-bugged characters aren't reset, so the workaround is to finish the questline on a new character in the same partition. It also fixes Horadric Cube rerolls for some affixes and a few boss and loot bugs.

your_games.title: Ocarina of Time previews are glowing
your_games.body: Hands-on previews of the Switch 2 remake went live alongside a new overview trailer. New additions include a jump button, the Hall of Fallen Heroes for boss rematches, fully voiced cutscenes, an orchestral score, and the option to hum or play ocarina songs into the Switch 2 microphone. It's out 5 Nov.

your_games.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is out today to strong reviews
your_games.body: Evil Empire's (Dead Cells) Castlevania sits at 86 on Metacritic and 85 on OpenCritic, per Polygon. GameSpot gave it 10/10 and Game Informer 9.25. IGN felt it plays more like a generic metroidvania than classic Castlevania, and The Guardian gave three stars for uneven pacing.

industry.title: Ubisoft moves to close RedLynx and cut Singapore jobs
industry.body: Ubisoft proposed shutting the Trials studio RedLynx in Finland (up to 52 jobs, pending local negotiations) and cut 70 roles at Ubisoft Singapore, the team behind Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced.

industry.title: Xbox reveals the pocket-sized Nano Controller
industry.body: It's just over 5 inches long and 3.5 ounces, with all 18 standard inputs, a rechargeable battery, a programmable Action Button, and Xbox Wireless plus Bluetooth. Pre-orders are open at $49.99 and it ships from November in a list of countries that doesn't include South Africa yet.

industry.title: 007 First Light dated for Switch 2: 18 March 2027
industry.body: IO Interactive locked the delayed Switch 2 version for 18 March 2027. The $69.99 Deluxe Edition is a game-key card, and pre-orders get a GoldenEye suit.

industry.title: Modern Warfare 4 preloads are live
industry.body: Preloads started last night. Campaign Early Access opens tomorrow (16 Oct) for digital pre-orders, DMZ opens to pre-order players on 20 Oct, and the full game unlocks at midnight local time on 23 Oct.

industry.title: Just Dance: Decades of Hits gets a free Switch 2 upgrade
industry.body: It's out now on Switch, and the free Switch 2 update with enhanced visuals arrives on 10 Nov.
